records.name: Punisher Shield
records.source_quest_or_shop: Parallel Quest 129 — Frieza Force on the Hunt
records.skill_description: Generate a barrier that stops an opponent's Ki Blast and launches one back at them; when the opponent or their Ki Blast touches the barrier, a follow-up kick is performed.
records.mechanics_notes: Punisher Shield creates a barrier that stops/reflects incoming Ki Blasts and can trigger a follow-up kick when an opponent or their Ki Blast contacts the barrier. It is cross-listed as a Counter Skill because of this defensive interception behavior. Exact duration, frame data, and damage measurements remain unresolved/version-sensitive.
records.acquisition_notes: Parallel Quest 129 — Frieza Force on the Hunt is the documented Future Warrior route. The skill is associated with Extra Pack 4 and SSGSS Gogeta. Exact random reward probability and an explicit Ultimate Finish dependency remain unresolved.
records.pve_notes: PQ129 is the documented farming route. No Ultimate Finish requirement is recorded because the reviewed evidence does not explicitly establish one.
records.pvp_notes: The barrier can function as a defensive counter against both incoming Ki Blasts and opponents entering its space. Community reports describe utility during rushes and combos; exact matchup/frame data is version-sensitive.
